shared_elements: band or field of closely spaced parallel incised lines
curved raised ridges dividing the surface
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in shallow relief and both include a plain circular disc and a zone of tightly ruled parallel incisions, which is the most specific overlap. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a tall, dark, heavily weathered upright with stacked, abstract-geometric and mask-like motifs arranged vertically about a central axis, while B is a pale, fine-grained horizontal fragment carrying comparatively naturalistic figural scenes with a standing figure and handled/rectangular object, so placement and manner of rendering scarcely correspond.
